delegation_basis: Author instruction 2026-09-23: 「devin一次判定で進めて / あとから検証します」; author instruction 2026-09-24: revise the candidate criterion first, freeze it, then select new candidates.
evidence_rule: Every gate cites segment IDs of the hash-checked retained article text in the screen directory; quotes must occur verbatim inside the cited segment. Original code, repositories, notebooks and author implementations were not consulted; files classified as implementation material in the route record were not opened.
deposit_inspection_rule: For deposits small enough to retrieve, the custodian retrieved the public files anonymously, retained them outside the public repository with a receipt (URL, UTC time, bytes, SHA-256, request conditions) and inspected only file structure (sheet names, column headers, first rows) to classify the deposit as analysis input, mixed input/output, or output. No analysis was run and no values were compared with the article. Files were not served to any reconstruction slot.
main_sample_rule: A route-eligible candidate becomes a main-sample candidate only if G1 = yes, G2 != no, the Stage B route has no exclusion class, the inspected deposit is analysis input (not the target output), and no file that would be served leaks the principal target. Candidates failing the deposit-role or leakage check are excluded with a recorded class; they are not reconstruction outcomes.

assessments.G1_reason: Central claims are genome sequences and sequence-identity/phylogenetic statistics computed from deposited reads (assembly, BLAST, MEGA X phylogeny, ANI/AAI).
assessments.G2_reason: Several numeric outputs are reported (>99.7% nucleotide identity for OlVV variants; 92-99.8% ANI between OlVA genomes; 22-63% AAI); the article does not single out one principal statistic, and identity values depend on assembled contigs that are themselves outputs (GenBank). A pre-specified target would have to be chosen by the author before blind slots are opened.
assessments.G3_reason: Trimmed reads are deposited under NCBI SRA BioProject PRJNA852409; the Stage B route lists sized files within the amendment caps and requires no account.
assessments.G4_reason: SPAdes, BLAST, MEGA X and ORF finder are free; no commercial software is named for the computational claims.
assessments.G5_reason: Assembler version and meta option are stated, but contig retention criteria and identity computation windows are only partly specified.
assessments.target_candidate: candidate: average nucleotide identity range between OlVA genome variants (92-99.8%) - requires author pre-specification
assessments.alternatives_considered: HSP70 phylogeny topology (qualitative; rejected); AAI ranges to related closteroviruses (depends on reference set).
assessments.deposit_inspection: Not retrieved: SRA run files are ~0.4-1 GiB each; only the listing was inspected. Listing shows read runs, not assembled contigs, so no target leakage is expected from the deposit itself; GenBank assemblies (outputs) are outside the served deposit.

assessments.G2_reason: Test-set accuracy of 98% (F1 0.98, AUC 0.98) for tumour detection is the headline result in abstract and results.
assessments.G3_reason: Raw spectral data and labels are deposited on Zenodo 17343533 (Corrections.zip, Labels.zip, Experiments.zip); Scripts.zip is implementation material and is withheld from the blind slots.
assessments.G4_reason: scikit-learn gradient boosting and HyperOpt are free.
assessments.G5_reason: Feature selection (ANOVA, P<0.10, 58 of 126 features), 5-fold CV and Bayesian tuning are described; the exact train/test split and hyperparameter search space sit in supplementary tables and the deposit README, so an attempt is possible but the split may not be recoverable without the withheld scripts.
assessments.target_candidate: held-out test-set accuracy (98%) and AUC (0.98) of the tumour detection model
assessments.alternatives_considered: External validation accuracy 89.8% (depends on separate cohort); glioma-vs-meningioma accuracy 71%.

assessments.G1_reason: Central claims are validation statistics of a lineage-mixture estimator (proportion of characteristic mutations detected; r^2 between estimated and expected lineage frequencies) computed from sequencing data of known mixtures.
assessments.G2_reason: r^2 = 0.995 (M. tuberculosis standards) and r^2 = 0.817 (SARS-CoV-2 standards) between estimated and expected lineage frequencies are stated.
assessments.G3_reason: SARS-CoV-2 raw reads are deposited under BioProject PRJNA827817 (sized, within caps). The article also requires lineage-characteristic mutation lists and VCF generation; the M. tuberculosis validation reads and the mutation lists are not confirmed in the Stage B route and may sit in the withheld software repository.
assessments.G4_reason: BCFtools/GATK and R are free; the article is itself a software paper whose package (MixviR) is the original implementation and is withheld.
assessments.G5_reason: The mixture design (seven SARS-CoV-2 standards, six M. tuberculosis standards) and estimator concept are described, but the frequency-estimation rule is defined by the package; reconstruction from text alone is a genuine test of specification sufficiency.
assessments.target_candidate: r^2 between MixviR-estimated and expected lineage frequencies for the SARS-CoV-2 standards (0.817) using reads from PRJNA827817
assessments.alternatives_considered: M. tuberculosis r^2 = 0.995 (input deposit not confirmed in route record); proportion of characteristic mutations detected (90-100%).
assessments.deposit_inspection: Not retrieved; listing inspected only. Expected lineage frequencies of the standards are stated in the article and figure, which is unavoidable and is not deposit leakage.
